notes: Wiki-synthetic part of the RASST retriever training data: Wikidata terms, Gemini-2.5-Flash sentences that contain each term, CosyVoice 3 speech, and the MFA-localized variable-context chunks used to train gavinlaw/rasst-retriever-hn1024.
The release keeps every built wiki row and flags the 2,567,645 rows that the hn1024 trainer kept after its p31_rank < 1,000,000 cutoff.
The GigaSpeech-derived part of the retriever training data is not included because GigaSpeech audio cannot be redistributed.
Chunk audio is packed as WebDataset tar shards (<key>.flac + <key>.json). FLAC is a lossless re-encode of the 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV files read by the trainer.
The original data pipeline is documented in code/legacy/documents/code/data_pre/wiki_synth/PIPELINE.md.

provenance.term_source: Wikidata RDF truthy dump: entities with an English rdfs:label and at least one wdt:P31 triple, ranked by inverse P31-type frequency
provenance.utterance_generator: Gemini-2.5-Flash, three 5-15 word utterance variants per term that contain the term verbatim
provenance.alignment: Montreal Forced Aligner word timestamps; chunks re-cut to 2.88, 3.84, 4.80 and 5.76 s contexts

hn1024_training.rule: the trainer skips rows with p31_rank >= 0 and p31_rank >= wiki_rank_cutoff
hn1024_training.log_evidence: [DATA] wiki_rank=1000000: kept 7,228,866, skipped 326,060 wiki entries beyond rank cutoff
